page.overview:
What is Al Dhanab?

AI Dhanab was a planet deliberately maintained by the Bene Gesserit Sisterhood as a mimic in the worse of Salusa Secundus, the old Corrino prison planet. It was a place worse even than Arrakis in some respects. According to Mother Superior Darwi Odrade, who had once been sent there, it had "high cliffs and dry gorges, hot winds and frigid winds, too little moisture and too much." Category:Planets
